commands.name: plugin_call
commands.output: string | null (op-specific; a list/object result is JSON-encoded into the string — see BrokerResult)
commands.description: §260 broker — authorizes a sandbox op by window.label() + registered capability (any-of for files/files:readonly), rate-limits per plugin and op class, executes bounded (caller-derived plugin id). Ops: storage_*, http_fetch, source_read, staged_read, files_read/write/list (vault-bounded, .baram refused). NOT ai — that is host-mediated over the sandbox transport. §260 Phase 4c: every result is a scalar (string or null); tauri queues a channel payload only when it is ≥8 KiB AND starts with { or [, so encoding lists/objects as a JSON string keeps them out of the ACL-exempt shared queue

commands.name: plugin_sandbox_register
commands.description: §260 host-only — register a sandbox plugin's granted capabilities (rejects sandbox-window callers)

commands.name: plugin_sandbox_deregister
commands.description: §260 host-only — drop a sandbox plugin's registered capabilities and its inbound message channel

commands.name: plugin_sandbox_connect
commands.description: §260 sandbox-only — register this webview's inbound IPC channel (requires prior host registration); a plugin-* window holds no event permission, so this is its only inbound path

commands.name: plugin_sandbox_report
commands.description: §260 sandbox-only — sandbox→host message; re-emitted as plugin:s2h with the plugin id stamped from the caller's window label

commands.name: plugin_sandbox_send
commands.description: §260 host-only — host→sandbox message over that sandbox's own IPC channel (fails closed if it has not connected)

commands.name: plugin_sandbox_stage
commands.description: §260 Phase 4b host-only — park a large payload (e.g. the document as markdown) for one sandbox to pull with PluginOp::StagedRead, so it arrives as an invoke result instead of a channel frame that would enter tauri's ACL-exempt channel-data queue
